title: Doc: Some title triggers multiple highlights in the left menu
body:
It's a bug.

**What is the current behavior?**

The highlight in the left menu is sometimes triggering multiple values

![2016-12-06 13 32 51](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/393765/20925810/43660f8a-bbb9-11e6-877d-2be6d72b6616.gif)

**What is the expected behavior?**

It should always highlight a single entry.
